short: Design tokens, the two skins and the paper look
is: The package's global styles and the model behind them: the design system's tokens as committed JSON, the stylesheet generated from them for both skins, the token parser, the skin and motion attribute names, the base and paper stylesheets, the controls' family stylesheets (`controls/`), and `index.ts`, the side-effect styles entry `@zurfur/ui/styles`.
conventions: Components take colour, space, shape and depth from the semantic tokens; times and easings are written only in `tokens.css`, the style scan's one exempt file.

The controls' looks are the seven family stylesheets in `controls/`, ported from the design system's bundle onto tokens. A look is the bundle's `zf-` class name, composed with the paper classes (`placed`, `pick`, `piece`, `slip`, `glidex`) rather than rewriting their lifts and glides: primary, secondary and destructive buttons are placed; quiet buttons and plain icon buttons are picks; fields are slips; tabs and the switch are one piece with pick options; the menu is a note whose rows are picks; the toggle's thumb is placed and glides.

A family file takes everything from tokens: no raw colour, time, easing or length, except `0`, 1px borders, the 2px focus ring, percentages and unitless numbers (a size the bundle writes raw takes the nearest size token). Motion belongs to the seam: no `animation` or keyframes, and no `transition` of `translate`, `transform`, `box-shadow`, `top`, `left`, `width` or `all`; colour fades on tokens stay. Resting states render from props, hover, focus and pressed come from interaction, and every focusable part shows the one focus ring.

`controls-css.spec` scans every file in `controls/` against these rules and checks that exactly the seven exist and the styles entry imports each, so the folder holds no other file, a `NODE.inf.json` included.

`tokens.json` is the design system's file byte for byte but two identifier samples, swapped for reserved examples by the recorded copy step (`yarn tokens:copy <version>`, `checks/tokens/copy.ts`, pinned by a masked hash); it is never edited by hand.
`tokens.additions.json` holds tokens pending the next design system revision (today `easing-linear`); the generator refuses an addition that the main file already has.
`tokens.css` is generated by `yarn tokens` from both JSON files and never edited; a spec fails when it differs from the generator's output.

`tokens.css` declares both skins (dark, and light under `data-skin='light'` or the OS colour scheme when no skin is set), redeclares every colour and shadow token per skin, collapses motion under reduced motion, and holds the Still block with its one scoped `!important` Still stop; nothing reads `data-motion='lively'`.

`token-model.ts` is the one parser of the token files and the home of the value allow-list the generator also applies; it holds each type style's size, line height and letter spacing to that allow-list and each type group's family to a token name, resolves a token per skin, and never throws, returning a refusal with its reason.
The two token JSON files are the only JSON files `src/` may hold besides nodes, allowed by exact path.

fs.role: the controls' looks, one stylesheet per family (button, field, check, toggle, tabs, menu, tip), each imported by `index.ts`; `controls-css.spec` holds them to the rules in this node's conventions, and the folder holds only those seven `.css` files
